name: Camp Laurel
description_short: Camp Laurel is a Maine summer camp in Readfield running one season, June 26 to August 11, 2027. The program includes boys' and girls' athletics, waterfront, tennis, adventure, arts ("Inter-Arts") and optional equestrian.
